media.note: David Gardiner (May 29, 1784 – February 28, 1844) was an American lawyer and politician who served as a member of New York State Senate from 1824 to 1828. He was the father of Julia Gardiner Tyler, second wife of U.S. President John Tyler.

death.place: USS Princeton, Potomac River near Mount Vernon

events.title: Education and career
events.description: Yale 1804; studied law with Sylvanus Miller; NY State Senator 1824-28; wrote 'Chronicles of East Hampton' (c.1840). [R4-S1]

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Juliana McLachlan, daughter of the brewer Michael McLachlan (from Jamaica; brewery near Chatham Square). [R4-S1]

bio: 4th cousin 7 times removed (Bull Smith -> Richard 2d -> Nathaniel -> Mary -> Capt. Abraham -> David). Killed by the bursting of the 'Peacemaker' gun aboard USS Princeton on 28 Feb 1844, one of seven killed. His widow's will was contested and rejected by the Court of Appeals, 'a celebrated Will case' ([R4-S1]).

conflicts.assessment: Unresolved; Gardiner is the family genealogy.
